title: Operator answers 'did the customer get the notification' from the outcome sink
asA: operator investigating a customer report of a missing notification (email, SMS, push, webhook)
iWant: every notification attempt to record an outcome on a durable sink queryable by recipient and time window
soThat: I answer whether the outcome was delivered, failed, pending, or suppressed without hunting a provider dashboard

acceptanceCriteria.description: Every notification attempt writes exactly one outcome record to the durable outcome sink before the attempting code returns; the record carries notificationId, channel, recipient, outcome, attemptedAt, and (when outcome is failed) errorCode fields.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process is instrumented to attempt one notification per invocation across each declared channel
acceptanceCriteria.when: an attempt is invoked and returns, and the sink is queried for that notificationId
acceptanceCriteria.then: the sink returns exactly one record for that notificationId with all required fields populated, and the record's attemptedAt is no later than the return time of the attempt call
acceptanceCriteria.templateFillIns: The applying agent sets the elicited notification-outcome-substrate; the AC substitutes the project's substrate for the illustrative sqlite.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The outcome field is one of a fixed enum (delivered, failed, pending, suppressed); the channel field is one of a fixed enum declared in configuration (email, sms, push, webhook, or the project's declared channel set).
acceptanceCriteria.given: the process attempts notifications across every declared channel including deliberately-failing and deliberately-suppressed cases
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sink is queried for the attempt records
acceptanceCriteria.then: every record's outcome field is one of delivered, failed, pending, or suppressed, and every record's channel field is a member of the declared channel enum
acceptanceCriteria.templateFillIns: The applying agent sets the elicited notification-outcome-substrate; the AC substitutes the project's substrate for the illustrative sqlite.

acceptanceCriteria.description: The operator queries the sink by recipient identifier and time window and receives the outcome records that match; a recipient with no attempts in the window returns an empty result rather than an error.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the sink holds outcome records across a mix of recipients and time windows
acceptanceCriteria.when: the operator issues a query for a recipient identifier within a bounded time window
acceptanceCriteria.then: the returned result set contains every outcome record whose recipient equals the queried recipient and whose attemptedAt is within the window, and a query for a recipient with zero matching records returns an empty result set

acceptanceCriteria.description: Notification outcome records persist across a process restart of the outcome sink: after N outcome records are written and the sink process is restarted, a query by recipient returns the same N records with the same fields as before the restart.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running application configured with the elicited notification-outcome-substrate on a durable path; 5 outcome records written with distinct recipient values
acceptanceCriteria.when: the sink process is stopped and restarted, then a query is issued for each recipient
acceptanceCriteria.then: the query returns 5 records; every returned record has the same outcome fields as the record that was written before the restart
acceptanceCriteria.templateFillIns: The applying agent supplies the elicited notification-outcome-substrate; the AC substitutes it for the illustrative sqlite path.

acceptanceCriteria.description: A failed write to the notification outcome sink (a substrate error, a full disk, a network partition on a remote substrate) is signalled to the caller with a stable-coded NOTIFICATION_OUTCOME_WRITE_FAILED error; the notification send call itself does not silently succeed with the outcome record lost.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running application with a notification-outcome-substrate that has been forced into a failure mode (a full disk on sqlite, a stopped postgres server)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the recordOutcome call rejects with NOTIFICATION_OUTCOME_WRITE_FAILED naming the substrate error; the notification's own send status reflects the failure per the caller's policy; a subsequent queryByRecipient shows no fabricated record for the failed write
acceptanceCriteria.templateFillIns: The applying agent supplies the failure-mode fixture per its chosen substrate (a disk fill for sqlite, a stopped daemon for postgres); the AC substitutes the substrate.
